title: Speed boost salchiblox speed hub scripts (OP)
script:
-- ============================================================================
-- 🌌 SALCHIBLOX HUB | SPEED EDITION (V10.5 ULTIMATE MASTER SCRIPT + BYPASS)
-- Creator: SALCHIBLOX
-- Theme: Red & Black / Fully Customizable UI, Starfall, & Rain Colors
-- Features: Universal Anti-Cheat Bypass, 1-1000 Speed, Avatar Scaler (-100 to 100),
--          Crosshair, Spinbot, WalkOnWater, Chat Spy, Waypoints, FPS Booster, Anti-AFK,
--          UI Scale (25%-150%), Anti-Ragdoll / Anti-Bat, Instant Proximity Grab,
--          Working Colored Starfall & Rain Particle Emitters.
-- ============================================================================

-- ============================================================================
-- 0. UNIVERSAL ANTI-CHEAT BYPASS MODULE
-- ============================================================================
pcall(function()
    local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
    local oldIndex = mt.__index
    local oldNamecall = mt.__namecall
    setreadonly(mt, false)

    -- Bypass property checks for WalkSpeed / JumpPower flags
    mt.__index = newcclosure(function(self, k)
        if not checkcaller() and (k == "WalkSpeed" or k == "JumpPower" or k == "HipHeight") then
            return 32
        end
        return oldIndex(self, k)
    end)

    setreadonly(mt, true)
end)

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or CoreGui

-- ============================================================================
-- 1. CONFIGURATION & CUSTOMIZATION DEFAULTS
-- ============================================================================
local Config = {
    HubName = "SALCHIBLOX HUB | SPEED EDITION",
    Creator = "SALCHIBLOX",
    TikTok = "https://www.tiktok.com/@prime_salchiblox",

    -- Theme Colors
    AccentColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 20, 60),

    Transparency = 0.08,
    UIScale = 1, -- Default 100%
    
    AnnouncementsText = "Welcome to Salchiblox Hub V10.5 Master Edition! Anti-Cheat Bypass Active.",
    
    -- Movement & Avatar
    SpeedEnabled = false,
    SpeedValue = 32,
    SpeedMultiplier = 1,
    JumpEnabled = false,
    JumpValue = 50,
    AvatarSizeValue = 0,
    AvatarSizeEnabled = false,
    AntiSlideEnabled = true,
    AntiFlingEnabled = true,
    NoclipEnabled = false,

    FlySpeed = 50,
    InfJumpEnabled = false,

    WalkOnWaterEnabled = false,

    SpinbotSpeed = 25,
    
    -- Combat, ESP & Protection
    ESPEnabled = false,

    -- World & Visuals
    GravityEnabled = false,
    GravityValue = 196.2,

    FOVValue = 70,
    InfZoomEnabled = false,
    TimeOfDayValue = 14,
    TimeOfDayEnabled = false,
    FPSBoosterEnabled = false,
    
    -- Utilities & Fun
    AutoClickerEnabled = false,
    AutoClickerCPS = 10,
    InvisibleEnabled = false,
    AutoRespawnEnabled = false,
    ChatSpyEnabled = false,
    AntiAFKEnabled = true,
    PanicKey = Enum.KeyCode.P,
    
    -- Crosshair
    CrosshairEnabled = false,
    CrosshairSize = 10,
    
    -- Waypoints
    Waypoint1 = nil,
    Waypoint2 = nil,
    Waypoint3 = nil,
    
    -- Particles & Color Customization
    StarfallEnabled = false,
    StarfallCount = 75,
    StarfallSpeed = 40,
    StarfallColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255),
    RainEnabled = false,
    RainAmount = 140,
    RainSpeed = 70,
    RainColor = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255),
}

-- Config System Functions (Max 5 Named Configs with Safe Local Storage File Handling)
local ConfigFolder = "SalchibloxHubConfigs"
pcall(function()
    if not isfolder(ConfigFolder) then
        makefolder(ConfigFolder)
    end
end)

local function getValidConfigName(name)
    local cleanName = name:gsub("[^%w_%-]", ""):sub(1, 20)
    if cleanName == "" then cleanName = "Config" end
    return cleanName
end

local function saveConfig(name)
    pcall(function()
        local safeName = getValidConfigName(name)
        local configsList = {}
        pcall(function()
            if isfile(ConfigFolder .. "/config_index.json") then
                configsList = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(ConfigFolder .. "/config_index.json"))
            end
        end)
        
        local found = false
        for _, cfgName in ipairs(configsList) do
            if cfgName == safeName then found = true break end
        end
        
        if not found then
            if #configsList >= 5 then
                table.remove(configsList, 1)
            end
            table.insert(configsList, safeName)
            writefile(ConfigFolder .. "/config_index.json", HttpService:JSONEncode(configsList))
        end
        
        local saveData = {
            UIScale = Config.UIScale,
            SpeedEnabled = Config.SpeedEnabled,
            SpeedValue = Config.SpeedValue,
            SpeedMultiplier = Config.SpeedMultiplier,
            JumpEnabled = Config.JumpEnabled,
            JumpValue = Config.JumpValue,
            AvatarSizeValue = Config.AvatarSizeValue,
            AvatarSizeEnabled = Config.AvatarSizeEnabled,
            AntiSlideEnabled = Config.AntiSlideEnabled,
            AntiFlingEnabled = Config.AntiFlingEnabled,
            NoclipEnabled = Config.NoclipEnabled,
            FlySpeed = Config.FlySpeed,
            InfJumpEnabled = Config.InfJumpEnabled,
            BhopEnabled = Config.BhopEnabled,
            WalkOnWaterEnabled = Config.WalkOnWaterEnabled,
            SpinbotEnabled = Config.SpinbotEnabled,
            SpinbotSpeed = Config.SpinbotSpeed,
            ESPEnabled = Config.ESPEnabled,
            AimbotEnabled = Config.AimbotEnabled,
            HitboxEnabled = Config.HitboxEnabled,
            HitboxSize = Config.HitboxSize,
            HitboxInf = Config.HitboxInf,
            AntiRagdollEnabled = Config.AntiRagdollEnabled,
            InstantGrabEnabled = Config.InstantGrabEnabled,
            GravityEnabled = Config.GravityEnabled,
            GravityValue = Config.GravityValue,
            FullbrightEnabled = Config.FullbrightEnabled,
            FOVValue = Config.FOVValue,
            InfZoomEnabled = Config.InfZoomEnabled,
            TimeOfDayValue = Config.TimeOfDayValue,
            TimeOfDayEnabled = Config.TimeOfDayEnabled,
            FPSBoosterEnabled = Config.FPSBoosterEnabled,
            AutoClickerEnabled = Config.AutoClickerEnabled,
            AutoClickerCPS = Config.AutoClickerCPS,
            ChatSpyEnabled = Config.ChatSpyEnabled,
            AntiAFKEnabled = Config.AntiAFKEnabled,
            StarfallEnabled = Config.StarfallEnabled,
            StarfallCount = Config.StarfallCount,
            StarfallColorR = Config.StarfallColor.R,
            StarfallColorG = Config.StarfallColor.G,
            StarfallColorB = Config.StarfallColor.B,
            RainEnabled = Config.RainEnabled,
            RainAmount = Config.RainAmount,
            RainColorR = Config.RainColor.R,
            RainColorG = Config.RainColor.G,
            RainColorB = Config.RainColor.B
        }
        
        writefile(ConfigFolder .. "/" .. safeName .. ".json", HttpService:JSONEncode(saveData))
    end)
end

local function loadConfig(name)
    pcall(function()
        local safeName = getValidConfigName(name)
        local filePath = ConfigFolder .. "/" .. safeName .. ".json"
        if isfile(filePath) then
            local fileContent = readfile(filePath)
            local loadedData = HttpService:JSONDecode(fileContent)
            for k, v in pairs(loadedData) do
                if k == "StarfallColorR" then
                    Config.StarfallColor = Color3.new(v, loadedData.StarfallColorG or 0, loadedData.StarfallColorB or 0)
                elseif k == "RainColorR" then
                    Config.RainColor = Color3.new(v, loadedData.RainColorG or 0, loadedData.RainColorB or 0)
                elseif Config[k] ~= nil then
                    Config[k] = v
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function getSavedConfigsList()
    local list = {}
    pcall(function()
        if isfile(ConfigFolder .. "/config_index.json") then
            list = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(ConfigFolder .. "/config_index.json"))
        end
    end)
    return list
end

-- Cleanup previous instances safely
if PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("SalchibloxHubSpeedEditionV9") then
    PlayerGui.SalchibloxHubSpeedEditionV9:Destroy()
end
if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("SalchibloxHubSpeedEditionV9") then
    CoreGui.SalchibloxHubSpeedEditionV9:Destroy()
end

-- ============================================================================
-- 2. UI CREATION & WINDOW CONTROLS

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "SalchibloxHubSpeedEditionV9"

ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

pcall(function() ScreenGui.Parent = PlayerGui end)
if not ScreenGui.Parent then ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui end

UIHolderScale.Parent = ScreenGui

-- Floating Reopen Button

TopBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)

TopBarCorner.Parent = TopBar

TopBarFix.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -14)
TopBarFix.BackgroundColor3 = Config.SecondaryColor
TopBarFix.BorderSizePixel = 0
TopBarFix.Parent = TopBar

TitleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 500, 1, 0)
TitleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 0)
TitleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TitleLabel.Text = Config.HubName .. " | V10.5 MASTER + BYPASS"
TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Config.TextColor

TitleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

local ControlsContainer = Instance.new("Frame")

local function createTopButton(name, text, xPos, callback)

    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, xPos, 0.5, -16)

    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = Config.TextColor

    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    c.Parent = btn
    
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
    return btn
end

local ToggleMainHub
createTopButton("MiniBtn", "⚡", 0, function() end)
createTopButton("HideBtn", "H", 38, function() ToggleMainHub(false) end)

ReopenButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ToggleMainHub(true) end)

function ToggleMainHub(state)

    ReopenButton.Visible = not state
end

-- ============================================================================
local AnnouncementBanner = Instance.new("Frame")
AnnouncementBanner.Name = "AnnouncementBanner"

-- ============================================================================
-- 4. STREAMLINED TAB NAVIGATION (6 ELITE WORKING TABS)
-- ============================================================================
local TabListContainer = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")

local ContentContainer = Instance.new("Frame")

local Tabs = {}

local TabNames = {
    "Dashboard & Chat",
    "Movement & Fly",
    "Combat & ESP",
    "World & Visuals",
    "Teleports & Players",
    "Theme & Settings"
}

for _, name in ipairs(TabNames) do
    local tabContent = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    tabContent.Name = name:gsub(" & ", ""):gsub(" ", "") .. "Tab"
    tabContent.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)

    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")

    local tabButton = Instance.new("TextButton")

    tabButton.Parent = TabListContainer
    
    local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

    Tabs[name] = { Button = tabButton, Content = tabContent }
    
    tabButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for _, t in pairs(Tabs) do
            t.Content.Visible = false
            t.Button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
            t.Button.TextColor3 = Config.TextColor
        end
        tabContent.Visible = true
        tabButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
        tabButton.TextColor3 = Config.AccentColor

end

-- Default tab
Tabs["Dashboard & Chat"].Content.Visible = true
Tabs["Dashboard & Chat"].Button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1

-- ============================================================================
-- UI BUILDER HELPERS
-- ============================================================================
local function createSectionHeader(parent, text)
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 28)

end

local function createToggle(parent, text, defaultState, callback)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 44)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Config.SecondaryColor
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
    frame.Parent = parent
    
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")

    c.Parent = frame
    
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 55)
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5
    stroke.Parent = frame
    
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -65, 1, 0)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = text
    lbl.TextColor3 = Config.TextColor
    lbl.TextSize = 13
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.Parent = frame
    
    local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 24)
    toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0.5, -12)
    toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = defaultState and Config.AccentColor or Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
    toggleBtn.Text = ""
    toggleBtn.Parent = frame
    
    local tc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    tc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    tc.Parent = toggleBtn
    
    local circle = Instance.new("Frame")
    circle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
    circle.Position = defaultState and UDim2.new(1, -22, 0.5, -10) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -10)
    circle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    circle.Parent = toggleBtn
    
    local cc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    cc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    cc.Parent = circle
    
    local state = defaultState
    toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state = not state
        toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = state and Config.AccentColor or Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
        circle.Position = state and UDim2.new(1, -22, 0.5, -10) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -10)
        callback(state)
    end)
    return frame
end

local function createSlider(parent, text, min, max, defaultVal, callback)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 64)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Config.SecondaryColor
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
    frame.Parent = parent
    
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    c.Parent = frame
    
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 55)
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5
    stroke.Parent = frame
    
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 28)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 6)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = text
    lbl.TextColor3 = Config.TextColor
    lbl.TextSize = 13
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.Parent = frame
    
    local valLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    valLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 75, 0, 28)
    valLbl.Position = UDim2.new(1, -85, 0, 6)
    valLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    valLbl.Text = tostring(defaultVal)
    valLbl.TextColor3 = Config.AccentColor
    valLbl.TextSize = 13
    valLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    valLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    valLbl.Parent = frame
    
    local sliderBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    sliderBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 8)
    sliderBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 40)
    sliderBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)
    sliderBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sliderBg.Parent = frame
    
    local sbgc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    sbgc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    sbgc.Parent = sliderBg
    
    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp((defaultVal - min) / (max - min), 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Config.AccentColor
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Parent = sliderBg
    
    local fc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    fc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    fc.Parent = fill
    
    local draggingSlider = false
    local function updateValue(input)
        local pos = math.clamp((input.Position.X - sliderBg.AbsolutePosition.X) / sliderBg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        local val = math.floor(min + (max - min) * pos)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(pos, 0, 1, 0)
        valLbl.Text = tostring(val)
        callback(val)
    end
    
    sliderBg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingSlider = true
            updateValue(input)
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingSlider = false
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if draggingSlider and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            updateValue(input)
        end
    end)
    return frame
end

local function createButton(parent, text, callback)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 42)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Config.SecondaryColor
    btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = Config.AccentColor
    btn.TextSize = 13
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.Parent = parent
    
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    c.Parent = btn
    
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Config.AccentColor

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        local hum = char.Humanoid
        local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
        
        -- Speed Modifier Logic with Lag Fix (>300 CFrame boost & normal base speed reset)
        if Config.SpeedEnabled then
            local targetSpeed = Config.SpeedValue * Config.SpeedMultiplier
            if targetSpeed > 300 then
                hum.WalkSpeed = 300
                if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                    hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + (hum.MoveDirection * (targetSpeed - 300) * dt)
                end
            else
                hum.WalkSpeed = targetSpeed
            end
        else
            hum.WalkSpeed = 16
        end

        if Config.JumpEnabled then
            hum.JumpPower = Config.JumpValue
        end

        if Config.BhopEnabled then
            if hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
                hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
            end
        end

        if Config.SpinbotEnabled then
            hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Config.SpinbotSpeed), 0)
        end

        if Config.WalkOnWaterEnabled then
            waterPlatform.Position = Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, 0, hrp.Position.Z)
            waterPlatform.CanCollide = true
        else
            waterPlatform.CanCollide = false
        end

        if Config.NoclipEnabled then
            for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end

        if Config.HitboxEnabled then
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    local targetHrp = p.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                    if Config.HitboxInf then
                        targetHrp.Size = Vector3.new(9999, 9999, 9999)
                    else
                        targetHrp.Size = Vector3.new(Config.HitboxSize, Config.HitboxSize, Config.HitboxSize)
                    end
                    targetHrp.Transparency = 0.7
                    targetHrp.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end

        if Config.AimbotEnabled then
            local closestPlayer = nil
            local shortestDist = math.huge
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    local dist = (hrp.Position - p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist < shortestDist then
                        shortestDist = dist
                        closestPlayer = p
                    end
                end
            end
            if closestPlayer and closestPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, closestPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
            end
        end

        if Config.StarfallEnabled then
            starfallEmitter.Position = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 30, 0)
            starfallEmitter.Rate = Config.StarfallCount
            starfallEmitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Config.StarfallColor)
        else
            starfallEmitter.Rate = 0
        end

        if Config.RainEnabled then
            rainEmitter.Position = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 30, 0)
            rainEmitter.Rate = Config.RainAmount
            rainEmitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Config.RainColor)
        else
            rainEmitter.Rate = 0
        end
    end

    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
            local charModel = p.Character
            if Config.ESPEnabled then
                if not charModel:FindFirstChild("SalchibloxESPHighlight") then
                    local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                    hl.Name = "SalchibloxESPHighlight"
                    hl.FillColor = Config.AccentColor
                    hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    hl.Parent = charModel
                end
            else
                local hl = charModel:FindFirstChild("SalchibloxESPHighlight")
                if hl then hl:Destroy() end
            end
        end
    end

    if Config.GravityEnabled then
        Workspace.Gravity = Config.GravityValue
    else
        Workspace.Gravity = 196.2
    end

    if Config.TimeOfDayEnabled then
        Lighting.TimeOfDay = tostring(Config.TimeOfDayValue) .. ":00:00"
    end
end)
